label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: blockers COMPLETE, other edges 10, samples with blocking 75

report.summary: Transfers show 41% 500s and multi-second p95 while ledger_app sessions were blocked by an idle-in-transaction session. Outbox delivery and the pool look healthy. The 500 errors' cause isn't directly confirmed.

findings.claim: Transfers endpoint is failing and slow: 283 of 684 requests returned 500, p95 3.9 s, p99 4.8 s.
findings.reason: Request metrics are complete and show a server_error_ratio of 0.4137 and multi-second tail latency.

findings.claim: ledger_app sessions were repeatedly blocked by one idle-in-transaction session (93481), with waits up to ~2 s.
findings.reason: Samples show blocked sessions 89839, 89840 and 89841 waiting on 93481 across 18:28:22-18:30:50, overlapping the symptom window.

findings.claim: Lock waits behind the idle-in-transaction session plausibly explain the slow transfers and some of the 500s; the pool and delivery path do not.
findings.reason: The pool had no timeouts or pending borrowers and deliveries succeeded in ~71 ms, so the DB lock waits are the remaining candidate. No trace links them to the 500s.

limitations: No error messages or stack traces for the 283 500s were available, so the link to lock waits is not confirmed.
Blocking is sampled every 2 s and only 50 of 59 relationships are listed, so the full blocking pattern is not shown.
next_checks: Check the application error logs for the 500s (lock timeout, deadlock or statement timeout) and match their timestamps to the blocked samples.
Identify session 93481 (query, application, transaction start) and why it stays idle in transaction; then see whether ending it clears the errors.

alternatives.reason: Arrivals equal publications and all 394 delivery attempts succeeded in ~71 ms. The 138 failed outbox rows are static and old (oldest undelivered age ~2700 s), so they predate the window.
alternatives.hypothesis: Outbox delivery failures cause the transfer errors.

alternatives.reason: There were 0 acquisition timeouts, 0 pending borrowers and a max of 8 active connections out of 10.
alternatives.hypothesis: Connection pool exhaustion causes the failures.

A.rule: a non-ledger_app session blocked ledger_app sessions in 75 samples
